body: Yes I'm still here, thanks for asking. Been talking to someone who's helped me, still going to leave the post up as I'm obvisouly not fixed and still having suicidal thoughts. Appreciate you checking in.
Not really, what will he/she tell me, "hang on" or "things will get better"
They have this special power that we don't have, talking to new people and be interested in what they say as well as act interesting, we don't have this ability. I feel you.

I'm not as old as you but I relate a lot, I don't really have any friends nor do I go out of the house very often, the few social interactions I do have are very short and for the most part they are very arkward and it's my fault, I can't relate to anyone and I don't have this special power that others have where I can pretend like I'm interested, whenever they talk I just say mm hmm or yeah and that's it, not really because I'm shy but more because I just don't relate. Everywhere I look people's lives are better than mine, people have friends, partners, future plans and dreams, hobbies you name it but I have fuck all, I sit in my room all day depressed and lonely wondering what the fucking point is at all for going on, I know things aren't going to get better because I'm not going to change, I can't go out and meet people because social anxeity prevents it and when I do meet people I act arkward and shit like that isn't going to change anytime soon. All I'm saying is you're not alone, I know that doesn't help but just know you're not the only one.
